mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM sys_flow_model m WHERE m.model_key = #{modelKey} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_flow_model SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, last_update_by = #{lastUpdateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT m.model_key, v.version AS model_version, v.deployment_id, v.process_definition_id FROM sys_flow_model m INNER JOIN sys_flow_model_version v ON v.model_id = m.id AND v.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND v.del_flag = 0 WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.model_key = #{modelKey} AND m.status = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0 AND v.version = #{modelVersion} AND v.publish_time IS NOT NULL AND v.deployment_id IS NOT NULL AND v.deployment_id <> '' AND v.process_definition_id IS NOT NULL AND v.process_definition_id <> '' LIMIT 1
